organization: Latino Child Care Association of Maryland, Inc
description:
Latino Child Care Association of Maryland (LCAM) was founded in 2010 as the first Latino child care association in the state. Since then, LCAM has grown into the largest, inspiring the creation of other organizations that were born out of its leadership and example.

Mission: LCAM’s mission is to empower Latino family child care and early childhood educators by providing bilingual training, technical assistance, and advocacy that address their unique cultural and developmental needs, while strengthening trust and positive connections between caregivers and families.

Vision: LCAM envisions a Maryland where Latino educators are fully supported in their first language, recognized for their expertise, and equipped with the resources needed to provide high‑quality early childhood education to all children, regardless of background.
